title: Product domains translated into QA coverage.
description: Systems from my CV reframed around software testing risks, coverage areas, and release evidence.

sections.title: Dhangadhi Service Bus
paragraphs: Municipal service workflows covering e-KYC, migration, recommendations, appointments, payments, Darta and Chalani, and notifications.
items: QA coverage: role permissions, document integrity, workflow transitions, notification targeting, and payment states
Testing value: protect citizen data and prevent inconsistent service decisions

sections.title: Vibe College
paragraphs: Dynamic enrollment forms, intake configuration, course selection, offer letters, fee installments, and application review.
items: QA coverage: conditional validation, draft recovery, file rules, reviewer actions, and offer-letter consistency
Testing value: keep applicant data complete, correct, and recoverable

sections.title: Syanko POS
paragraphs: Order management, kitchen tickets, billing, taxes, discounts, payment processing, and thermal receipts.
items: QA coverage: duplicate submissions, totals, discounts, tax calculation, kitchen synchronization, payment ambiguity, and receipt retries
Testing value: reduce billing mistakes and keep kitchen/order state aligned

sections.title: More QA coverage areas
items: Hello Palika: citizen communication, appointments, complaints, decisions, and notifications
CTF School Management: report cards, grades, rankings, and attendance summaries
Chiurika: eCommerce CMS content, product data, and publishing checks
Connect Kisan: creating, scheduling, and delivering notifications
Dwarika Engineering: responsive UI, motion behavior, page performance, and browser checks
Personal projects: booking flows, CV generation, property management flows, and food ordering scenarios
